segments.comment: Valid independent selected-location recipe for pager.c do_look. The two spaces acknowledge the quick-look prompt and first-use cursor tip, then . selects the blind hero square. JavaScript incorrectly enters checkfile and its yes/no prompt because do_look omits the C !quick condition, leaving an extra --More-- and the top-line cursor. Keep this input-only recipe until that separate quick-mode condition is corrected; tty_putmixed itself can wait through tty_putstr/update_topl and is not the confirmed cause.
